title: Liverpool ring which jockeyed the Galway harbour scheme.
html_source:
Taken from “The Merchant of Modernism: The Economic Jew in Anglo-American Literature”
By Gary Levine:

According to Gifford, the failure of Galway as a transatlantic port was caused by the maritime incompetence of the harbor’s promoters, not by Liverpool shipping interests fearing the competition of Galway. Deasy’s tendency to see conspiracies and intrigues is typical of an Irish managerial class that looks for scapegoats to explain its uncompetiveness.
